public_requirements: Export SlotInvalidatedRunEventPayload and SlotInvalidatedRunEventDetail from run-event.ts and include slot_invalidated in the exported RunEvent union with that payload.
Require a non-null run_unit_id and output_name and a detail carrying a string invalidation_kind, rejecting a missing field with an error naming the sequence and operation.
Expose superseded_by on the payload as the artifact revision that replaced the invalidated slot, or null when nothing replaced it.
Select the superseding revision in PostgresOperatorProjectionRepository.list_run_events so it reaches consumers.
Announce an invalidated slot on its own slot_invalidated server-sent event rather than the generic run_event frame.
Preserve the row's sequence, occurrence time and existing payload fields on the projected event.
